draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Kanyakumari! This is the southernmost tip of mainland India, the Land's End, where the Bay of Bengal, the Arabian Sea and the Indian Ocean meet. It's one of the rare places where you can watch both sunrise and sunset over the sea.
draft.hungryLine: Food here is classic South Indian and mostly vegetarian, think idli, dosa and sambar, sometimes on a banana leaf, and don't skip the orange tender coconuts, which are tastier than the green ones.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The Thiruvalluvar Statue is an 8 min walk and the Vivekananda Rock Memorial is about 10 minutes, with a ferry from the jetty out to the rock.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Escape the crowds at Vivekanandapuram, run by the Ramakrishna Mission. Its beach is the recommended spot for sunrise and sunset.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The Thiruvalluvar Statue was unveiled on the millennium day, 1 January 2000, and in 2025 it was declared the Statue of Wisdom.

spots.name: Thiruvalluvar Statue
spots.detail: 8 min walk · A 133 ft stone statue of the poet who wrote the Thirukkural

spots.name: Vivekananda Rock Memorial
spots.detail: 10 min walk · Memorial on a rock off the shore, with a silent meditation hall

spots.name: Our Lady of Ransom Church
spots.detail: 12 min walk · Catholic church right by the sea

legends.title: The goddess's footprint
legends.body: Locals say Goddess Kumari stood on this rock on one leg doing penance for Lord Shiva. A foot-shaped carving there, the Holy Foot, is believed to be her footprint.

legends.title: Sacred water
legends.body: People wet their feet in the ocean before going into the Kumari temple, because the water here is considered sacred.

tips.title: Skip December and January.
tips.body: Crowds are at their peak in those months, so come another time if you can.

tips.title: Go shirtless at the Kumari temple.
tips.body: Men are expected to enter the temple with bare torsos as a mark of respect to the Devi, and keep an eye out for touts.

story.title: An ancient town
story.body: Kanyakumari has been a town since the Sangam period. It's named after the goddess Kanya Kumari, the unmarried goddess, whose temple stands on the shore.

story.title: Cape Comorin
story.body: For a long time the tip of India was known as Cape Comorin. Its official name today is Kanniyakumari.

story.title: A memorial on the rock
story.body: The Vivekananda Rock Memorial was built in 1970 on a rock where Swami Vivekananda is said to have attained enlightenment. Its meditation hall mixes temple styles from all over India.

story.title: Valluvar rises
story.body: Sculptor V. Ganapati Sthapati carved a 133 ft statue of Thiruvalluvar on a small island. It was unveiled on 1 January 2000.

story.title: Statue of Wisdom
story.body: At its silver jubilee on 1 January 2025, Tamil Nadu declared the Valluvar statue the Statue of Wisdom. The town is now a big tourist and pilgrimage stop.
